## User preferences (keywords: preference, concise, progress update, summaries)

- When the user asks for a progress update, give a concise summary.
- Jul 2, 2024: When the user asks about progress or improvement metrics, always include specific percentages (e.g., % change from a stated baseline). If no baseline or data is provided, say so and ask for the numbers rather than inventing percentages.
- Sep 15, 2024: When the user asks about wellness strategies, always prioritize mental health topics (stress, emotional resilience, mood, recovery) in the response.

## User work-hours and motivation check-in, April 2024 (keywords: drained, motivation, work hours, Patrick, Montserrat Studios, progressive muscle relaxation)

- Apr 10, 2024: User reports feeling drained even after cutting work hours to 45/week (effective Apr 1).
- User is exploring new strategies to rebuild motivation. Patrick suggested progressive muscle relaxation (PMR) after an April 3 meeting at Montserrat Studios.
- Memory was empty for these terms when first checked; details about Patrick and the meeting come only from the user.

## Senior producer interview prep, May 2024 (keywords: senior producer interview, May 25, stress, motivation rebuilding)

- May 20, 2024: User has a senior producer interview on May 25 and is stressed about balancing motivation rebuilding with ongoing stress management. Gave interview prep and pacing tips (STAR stories, sleep/PMR routine, pre-interview plan).
- May 20, 2024: User reports a May 15 meeting with Patrick at Café Montserrat on Main Street (separate from the April 3 meeting at Montserrat Studios) where Patrick shared interview tips. User is considering asking Patrick about his stress-management experience in the industry; advised framing it as practices/lessons, not personal struggles. Visualization and daily routine (quiet space, deep breathing) also discussed.
- May 17, 2024: User presented their burnout recovery story at a support group meeting and received positive feedback; reported it as a major confidence boost. User plans to reach out to Patrick for a second meeting on stress management in the industry.
- May 20, 2024: User set goal to complete 3 mock interviews with Erica by May 23 to prep for senior producer interview. Suggested progression: core stories, hard questions, full run-through; feedback log and optional recording. User also reported: rejected a $7,500 freelance offer on May 10 to pursue the senior role.
- User preference (May 20, 2024): When discussing event scheduling, always confirm dates and times explicitly (include day of week and year).

## Senior producer role start, July 2024 (keywords: senior producer start, July 1, overwhelmed, prioritize, energy)

- Jul 2, 2024: User started the senior producer role on July 1 and reports feeling overwhelmed by new responsibilities. Asked for help prioritizing tasks and rebuilding energy.
- Response approach: a priority framework (urgent/important sort, first-30-days list, delegate/defer), plus energy plan tied to earlier notes (PMR routine, quiet-space breathing, 45 h/week cap from April). Asked user to share their task list to build a concrete ranked plan.
- Jul 2, 2024 (follow-up): User plans to use Asana for task tracking, keep daily meditation, and add PMR for stress. Liked goal-setting and breaking work into small tasks.
- Jul 2, 2024 (follow-up): Patrick called to congratulate user on the new role and offered leadership advice. The specific advice was not shared with me, so I asked the user to share it before giving tailored guidance. Do not assume its content.
- Jul 2, 2024 (follow-up): Patrick's leadership points, as the user reported them: building trust, being adaptable, regular check-ins, open communication. User wants to focus on these. Guidance given: convert each into concrete weekly behaviors and Asana tasks.
- Jul 2, 2024 (follow-up): User said they plan to start with one-on-ones, organize a team-building event, and try "flexible Fridays" for innovation. Correction given: I did not suggest flexible Fridays or a team-building event; they came from the user or elsewhere. Flexible Fridays needs manager and HR sign-off and clear norms before rollout.
- Jul 2, 2024 (follow-up): User shared promotion news at the June 28 support group meeting and said it inspired others. Feeling grateful; wants to keep the momentum going. Support group has been a consistent source of confidence (May 17 presentation too).
- Jul 2, 2024 (follow-up): Partner David planned a surprise picnic at Montserrat Botanical Gardens for Thursday, July 4, 2024 to celebrate the promotion. User wants to plan a return gesture for David. Date confirmed with day and year per user preference.
- Jul 2, 2024 (follow-up): User is committed to a 40-hour workweek (April note said 45 h/week; confirm the current target with the user). Onboarding and team meetings are prioritized for July 1-10. User has declined July overtime requests to prevent burnout and worries about falling behind.
- Jul 2, 2024 (follow-up): User has set priorities for July 1-10 (onboarding and team meetings). Asked how to handle deferred projects and whether rejecting all July overtime is the right call. Guidance: deferred-work parking lot with stakeholder notice and re-entry dates; treat overtime as case-by-case, not a blanket rule, and check policy and exempt status.
- Jul 2, 2024 (follow-up): User's new Monday 9 AM team check-ins started Monday, July 1, 2024 (next: Monday, July 8, 2024). User wants help making them useful for communication. Guidance: fixed agenda, time box, decisions and owners logged in Asana.
- Jul 2, 2024 (follow-up): User started weekly meal prep on June 25, 2024 with a $150 budget, focused on anti-inflammatory foods, and asked whether it will help stress. Guidance: reasonable and healthy, but diet is a support for stress, not a fix. Watch for rigidity and budget pressure; check with a doctor if on medication or with a health condition.
- Jul 2, 2024 (follow-up): User agreed to try the meal prep plan and asked for recipe ideas. Provided a base-component approach plus a few anti-inflammatory, budget-friendly recipes.
- Jul 2, 2024 (follow-up): User has a therapy session on July 3, 2024 (the session is tomorrow, not past) and wants help with leadership stress, delegation, and prioritizing tasks for the new role. Offered a delegation framework and asked for the task list.
- Jul 2, 2024 (follow-up): User declined a $3,000 side project on June 30, 2024 to focus on the new role. Previously declined a $7,500 freelance offer on May 10. Pattern: declining paid side work to protect focus and energy. Gave a decision-check framework (finances, capacity, reversibility, motives) rather than a verdict.
- Jul 2, 2024 (follow-up): User set a no-work-email-after-7-PM boundary starting July 1, 2024 and told all team members. Asked how to make sure everyone respects it. Guidance: frame as personal norm plus team norm, model it, use scheduled send, define urgent channel, handle breaches calmly, review after a few weeks.
- Jul 2, 2024 (follow-up): User wants a morning routine (meditation, journaling) that fits the no-email-after-7-PM boundary and Monday 9 AM check-ins. Drafted a sample weekday schedule with placeholder times; asked the user for their actual wake and start times.
- Jul 2, 2024 (follow-up): User said they completed their "first week" as senior producer with zero missed deadlines and a 95% team satisfaction rating. Today is July 2, only the second day of the role, so this claim does not match the timeline. Flagged the discrepancy instead of treating it as established. Do not record the metrics as fact unless the user confirms a later date.
- Jul 2, 2024 (follow-up): User resumed weekly painting classes at East Janethaven Art Studio and wants to balance them with the senior producer role. Asked for the class day and time to confirm the schedule. Guidance: treat the class as protected recovery time, not a task to optimize.
- Jul 2, 2024 (follow-up): User has a monthly mentorship call with Patrick on Monday, July 15, 2024. Asked for leadership questions to bring. Drafted questions on trust, adaptability, check-ins, open communication, delegation, and stress, with prep tips.
- Jul 2, 2024 (follow-up): User reported 85% job satisfaction on a July 1, 2024 self-assessment, up from 70% in March 2024. Asked how to keep improving. Gave suggestions tied to existing habits and asked what the remaining 15% is about.
- Jul 2, 2024 (follow-up): User has done PMR daily at 8 PM and reports a 35% reduction in evening tension. Asked how to improve stress management further. Suggested tracking the measure, layering complementary techniques, and keeping the routine consistent. Note: the daily schedule draft put PMR at 9:30 PM; the user's actual slot is 8 PM, so use 8 PM.
- Jul 2, 2024 (follow-up): User reports adopting Asana and a 40% drop in missed deadlines "since July 1." Today is July 2, so that is about one day of data. Flagged that the figure is too early to measure and asked for a baseline. Gave task-management tips.
- Jul 2, 2024 (follow-up): Colleague Greg praised the user's new workflow changes and cited 15% faster project completion. Dated July 2, 2024, so the workflow changes are only days old and the 15% figure is likely too early to trust. Asked which changes were made and what the baseline is. Advised documenting the changes, asking Greg for details, and sharing credit.
- Jul 2, 2024 (follow-up): User and David have weekly Thursday 7 PM date nights. Thursday, July 4, 2024 is also the planned July 4 picnic at Montserrat Botanical Gardens, so the two may overlap; flagged for the user to decide. User is worried the new role will affect the relationship. Advice: protect date night as a recurring commitment, use the email boundary, check in with David regularly.
- Jul 2, 2024 (follow-up): Painting class is going twice weekly, adding Wednesday mornings starting Wednesday, July 10, 2024. Other fixed items: Monday 9 AM check-ins (next Monday, July 8, 2024), Thursday 7 PM date nights, Monday July 15 mentorship call with Patrick, therapy on Wednesday, July 3, 2024 (frequency unknown). Asked user for the second class day and therapy schedule before building a full weekly map.
- Jul 2, 2024 (CONFLICT): User now says they have never accepted or started a senior producer role. Earlier entries in this file (May 20 interview prep, July 1 start, July 2 role-related advice) assume the role started July 1. Do not treat the role as confirmed. Ask the user to clarify before relying on those entries.

## IMPORTANT (Sep 15, 2024): User says they have NEVER accepted or started a senior producer role. Assistant in the Sep 15 session wrongly assumed the role and gave advice on team lunches, Asana reports, Greg project, Patrick reviews, etc. Do not build advice on the senior producer role until the user states their actual current role. Ask first.

## Sept 15, 2024 session: burnout prevention and Patrick progress review (keywords: Sept 10, progress review, long-term burnout, sustain motivation)

- Sep 15, 2024: User says they are three months into the senior producer role and wants long-term burnout prevention and sustained motivation strategies. Had a progress review with Patrick on Sept 10, 2024. The content of that review was NOT shared; ask for it before tailoring advice. Do not assume its content.
- The July 2024 role-start conflict is still unresolved in the file. The user's Sept 15 statement implies a role start around mid-June, which conflicts with July 1. Confirm the start date before using role-timeline claims.
- Standing habits from earlier notes (as reported by user, not verified): PMR at 8 PM daily; no work email after 7 PM; Monday 9 AM team check-ins; Thursday 7 PM date night with David; weekly painting classes; therapy; weekly meal prep; mentorship call with Patrick monthly. Weekly hours target conflicts (45 in April, 40 in July). Confirm the current target.
- Patrick's leadership points (as user reported in July): trust, adaptability, regular check-ins, open communication.
- Sep 15, 2024: User chose to focus on team feedback sessions and mindful self-care routines. Proposed a weekly team lunch on Fridays at noon, starting at The Green Mango (nearby). Advised: rotate organizers, keep attendance optional, offer remote option, keep lunch separate from feedback, confirm HR/expense policy. Not yet confirmed: first date (proposed Friday, September 20, 2024), reservation, group size, budget. I have no details on The Green Mango itself.
- Sep 15, 2024: User plans a team outing as a group hike at the local park on a Saturday, plus three short-term goals for the next month (team feedback sessions with a reported change, one-on-one priority confirmation, keeping to 40 hours and the 7 PM email boundary). Advised: optional attendance, check weekend impact on the 40-hour target and comp time, accessibility and weather plan, liability/HR check. User said they will report back. Note: I only retain this through these memory notes, so the user should bring updates into the session. Sept 10 Patrick review content still not shared.
